user.title: Choose Connection Type
user.description: Select how you want to connect to your S7 PLC.

rack_slot.title: Connect to S7 PLC (Rack/Slot)
rack_slot.description: Enter your S7 PLC connection details using Rack and Slot. A connection test will run before saving.

data_description.name: A friendly name for the PLC (used in entity names).
data_description.host: IP or hostname of the PLC.
data_description.pys7_connection_type: S7 connection type (PG – programming, OP – operator panel, S7 Basic – basic connection).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PLC, in seconds. Use decimal values for millisecond precision.
data_description.operation_timeout: Maximum duration for a single read/write cycle before retrying.
data_description.max_retries: How many times to retry a failed PLC operation before giving up.
data_description.retry_backoff_initial: Delay before the first retry attempt.
data_description.optimize_read: Enable optimized batch reads to improve performance. If you experience read errors, disable this option.
data_description.enable_write_batching: Automatically group writes together. When multiple entities update simultaneously, writes are combined into a single PLC request (50ms window). Improves performance for scenes and bulk operations.
data_description.enable_metrics: Enable performance metrics. Collects and reports performance data for monitoring and optimization.

connection.title: Edit PLC Connection
connection.description: Update the PLC host, rack, slot, and communication timing parameters. A connection test will run before saving.

data_description.name: A friendly name for the PLC (used in entity names).
data_description.host: IP or hostname of the PLC.
data_description.pys7_connection_type: Type of S7 connection (PG for programming, OP for operator panel, S7 Basic for basic connection).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PLC, in seconds. Use decimal values for millisecond precision.
data_description.operation_timeout: Maximum duration for a single read/write cycle before retrying.
data_description.max_retries: How many times to retry a failed PLC operation before giving up.
data_description.retry_backoff_initial: Delay before the first retry attempt.
data_description.optimize_read: Enable optimized batch reads to improve performance. If you experience read errors, disable this option.
data_description.enable_write_batching: Enable automatic batching of writes. When multiple entities update simultaneously, writes are grouped into a single PLC request (50ms window). Improves performance for scenes and bulk operations.
data_description.enable_metrics: Enable performance metrics. Collects and reports performance data for monitoring and optimization.

sensors.title: Add Sensor
sensors.description: Create a sensor that reads a value from the PLC (e.g., DB, MW, etc.). Provide the address and optionally a name.

data_description.address: PLC address to read (e.g., DB1000,D0, MW10, DB1,W2).
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the sensor.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.device_class: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., battery, power).
data_description.value_multiplier: Multiply the raw PLC value before reporting it. Leave blank to keep the original value.
data_description.scale_raw_min: Minimum raw (PLC) value for linear scaling. All four scale fields must be filled to activate scaling.
data_description.scale_raw_max: Maximum raw (PLC) value for linear scaling.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Custom unit of measurement (e.g., °C, RPM, bar). Leave blank to use the default unit based on device class.
data_description.state_class: State class for statistics: 'measurement' for instantaneous values, 'total' for cumulative values that can decrease, 'total_increasing' for counters (e.g., energy, water consumption). Leave blank for automatic.
data_description.real_precision: Number of decimal places for REAL values. Leave blank to use the default (1).
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more sensors.

binary_sensors.title: Add Binary Sensor
binary_sensors.description: Create a binary sensor (on/off) from the PLC. Set the address, name, and optional device_class.

data_description.address: PLC boolean address (e.g., I0.0, Q1.3, DB10,X0.1).
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the binary sensor.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.device_class: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., door, window, power).
data_description.invert_state: Invert the state: PLC True becomes Off, PLC False becomes On. Useful for NC (Normally Closed) contacts.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more binary sensors.

switches.title: Add Switch
switches.description: Create a switch with a state address and an optional command address. You can enable state synchronization.

data.name: Name
data.sync_state: Write external state changes to command address

data_description.state_address: PLC address to read the current state (e.g., Q0.0, DB20,X0.0).
data_description.command_address: PLC address to write commands (optional). If omitted, only state will be read.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the switch.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.sync_state: When the state address changes externally, write the new state to the command address.
data_description.pulse_command: When enabled, sends a pulse (ON then OFF) instead of a continuous state. Useful for bistable relays or flip-flop circuits.
data_description.pulse_duration: Duration of the pulse in seconds. Minimum: 0.1s, Maximum: 60s.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more switches.

covers_traditional.title: Add Cover (Open/Close)
covers_traditional.description: Create a cover with dedicated open/close command addresses and optional opening/closing state feedback.

data_description.open_command_address: PLC address to trigger opening (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.0).
data_description.close_command_address: PLC address to trigger closing (e.g., Q0.1, DB1,X0.1).
data_description.opening_state_address: Optional PLC address that indicates the cover is opened.
data_description.closing_state_address: Optional PLC address that indicates the cover is closed.
data_description.cover_opening_address: Optional boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is currently opening. Independent of the opened/closed end-stop addresses above.
data_description.cover_closing_address: Optional boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is currently closing. Independent of the opened/closed end-stop addresses above.
data_description.cover_stopped_address: Optional boolean PLC address that indicates the cover is stopped (not moving).
data_description.cover_status_address: Optional PLC address reporting real-time movement (opening/closing/stopped), matched against the value(s) configured below. Takes priority over the boolean opening/closing/stopped status addresses above when configured.
data_description.cover_status_open_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully open, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the end-stop based state. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_closed_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully closed, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the end-stop based state. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_opening_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is opening, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_closing_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is closing, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_stopped_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is stopped (not moving), read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.operate_time: Seconds to keep the command active before resetting the outputs and clearing the movement state.
data_description.use_state_topics: Enable to use state feedback addresses for determining cover position. When disabled, position is inferred from operate time.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the cover.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.device_class: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., shutter, blind, garage).
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for these tags in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more covers.

covers_position.title: Add Cover with Position
covers_position.description: Create a cover controlled by position values (0-100). State 0 means CLOSED, values >= 1 mean OPEN.

data_description.position_state_address: PLC address to read the current position value (0-100, e.g., DB1,B0, DB2,W4).
data_description.position_command_address: PLC address to write position commands (0-100). If omitted, the state address is used.
data_description.stop_command_address: PLC boolean address to pulse when stop is pressed. If omitted, stop writes the current position back.
data_description.stop_pulse_duration: Duration in seconds for the stop pulse (supports decimals, e.g., 0.5 for 500ms).
data_description.tilt_state_address: Optional PLC address to read the current tilt position (0-100). Enables tilt control (open/close/set/stop tilt) for this cover.
data_description.tilt_command_address: PLC address to write tilt position commands (optional). If omitted, the tilt state address is used.
data_description.invert_tilt: Invert the tilt scale (0 becomes 100 and vice versa), for actuators wired the opposite way.
data_description.cover_status_address: Optional PLC address reporting real-time movement (opening/closing/stopped), matched against the value(s) configured below. Without it, the cover won't report as opening/closing and only the raw position is used.
data_description.cover_status_open_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully open, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the position-based state. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_closed_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is fully closed, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. When matched, the cover's closed state is determined by this, taking priority over the position-based state. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_opening_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is opening, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_closing_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is closing, read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.cover_status_stopped_values: PLC value(s) meaning the cover is stopped (not moving), read from the status address above. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the cover.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.device_class: Home Assistant device class to refine the UI/behavior (e.g., shutter, blind, garage).
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for these tags in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.invert_position: Enable if your PLC uses 0 for fully open and 100 for fully closed (reverses the normal logic).
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more position-based covers.

buttons.title: Add Button
buttons.description: Create a stateless button that pulses a PLC boolean address for the configured number of seconds when pressed.

data_description.address: PLC boolean address to pulse (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.1).
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the button.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more buttons.
data_description.button_pulse: Duration of the pulse in seconds.

lights.title: Add Light
lights.description: Configure a light with a boolean state/command address. Optionally add dimmer support by setting brightness addresses and scale.

data.name: Name
data.sync_state: Write external state changes to command address

data_description.state_address: PLC boolean address to read the on/off state (e.g., DB1,X0.0).
data_description.command_address: PLC boolean address to write on/off commands (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the light.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.sync_state: When the state address changes externally, write the new on/off state to the command address.
data_description.pulse_command: Send pulse instead of on/off commands.
data_description.pulse_duration: Duration of the pulse in seconds (0.1-60s, supports decimals). Default: 0.5s.
data_description.brightness_scale: Maximum value the PLC uses for full brightness (e.g., 255 for BYTE, 100 for percentage). Required when brightness addresses are set.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more lights.
data_description.brightness_state_address: PLC numeric address to read the brightness level (e.g., DB1,B2). Leave blank for on/off only.
data_description.brightness_command_address: PLC numeric address to write brightness commands (optional). If omitted, the brightness state address is used.

numbers.title: Add Number
numbers.description: Create a number entity that reads a value from the PLC and can optionally write commands back.

data_description.address: PLC address to read the numeric value (e.g., DB1,D0, DB2,W4).
data_description.command_address: PLC address to write values (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the number entity.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.device_class: Device class for the number entity (e.g., temperature, voltage, power).
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Custom unit of measurement (e.g., °C, V, kW). Leave blank if not needed.
data_description.min_value: Optional minimum bound for the value shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.max_value: Optional maximum bound for the value shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.step: Optional increment used when adjusting the value in the UI.
data_description.value_multiplier: Multiply the raw PLC value before reporting it. Leave blank to keep the original value.
data_description.scale_raw_min: Minimum raw (PLC) value for linear scaling. All four scale fields must be filled to activate scaling.
data_description.scale_raw_max: Maximum raw (PLC) value for linear scaling.
data_description.real_precision: Number of decimal places for REAL values. Leave blank to use the default (1).
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more number entities.

texts.title: Add Text
texts.description: Create a text entity that reads STRING or WSTRING values from the PLC and can optionally write text back.

data_description.address: PLC STRING or WSTRING address to read (e.g., DB1,S0.254, DB2,WS0.128).
data_description.command_address: PLC address to write text values (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the text entity.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.pattern: Optional regex pattern to validate the text input.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for this tag in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more text entities.

climates_direct.title: Add Climate (Direct Control)
climates_direct.description: Create a climate entity where Home Assistant controls heating/cooling outputs directly. The PLC provides temperature readings only.

data_description.current_temperature_address: PLC address to read current temperature (e.g., DB1,REAL0, DB2,INT4).
data_description.heating_output_address: PLC address to control heating output (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.0). Optional if only cooling is used.
data_description.cooling_output_address: PLC address to control cooling output (e.g., Q0.1, DB1,X0.1). Optional if only heating is used.
data_description.heating_action_address: Optional PLC address to read heating action state. If not specified, action is inferred from mode.
data_description.cooling_action_address: Optional PLC address to read cooling action state. If not specified, action is inferred from mode.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the climate entity.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for these tags in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more climate entities.

climates_setpoint.title: Add Climate (Setpoint Control)
climates_setpoint.description: Create a climate entity where the PLC manages heating/cooling autonomously. Home Assistant writes the target temperature and reads the current temperature.

data_description.current_temperature_address: PLC address to read current temperature (e.g., DB1,REAL0, DB2,INT4).
data_description.target_temperature_address: PLC address to write and read target temperature setpoint (e.g., DB1,REAL4, DB2,INT8).
data_description.preset_mode_address: Optional PLC address to write the HVAC mode, using the value configured below for each mode. Write-only by default; enable HVAC mode feedback to also read it back.
data_description.preset_mode_bidirectional: Read the HVAC mode address from the PLC and use a recognized value as the current HVAC mode. Disabled by default because some PLCs reset or modify command addresses independently, which could misreport the mode.
data_description.on_off_address: Optional boolean PLC address to switch this thermostat on/off, for devices with no native OFF mode of their own (e.g. a heater/cooler turned on/off by a separate output). Writes False/0 when the target mode is set to OFF, and True/1 for any other mode. Leave blank to rely on the standard OFF behavior instead. Also read back from the PLC to reflect the actual on/off state (bidirectional).
data_description.preset_mode_off_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to OFF (e.g. 0). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list. If on_off_address is configured, this is ignored for OFF: the mode stays available and is switched via that address instead.
data_description.preset_mode_heat_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT (e.g. 1). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.
data_description.preset_mode_cool_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to COOL (e.g. 2). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.
data_description.preset_mode_heat_cool_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT/COOL (auto) (e.g. 3). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.
data_description.preset_mode_auto_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to AUTO (legacy alias for automatic heat/cool switching, similar to Heat/Cool). Disabled (left empty) by default.
data_description.preset_mode_dry_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to DRY (dehumidify only, no temperature control). Disabled (left empty) by default.
data_description.preset_mode_fan_only_value: PLC value written when the mode is set to FAN ONLY (circulate air only, no heating/cooling). Disabled (left empty) by default.
data_description.hvac_status_address: Optional PLC address to read the actual HVAC status, matched against the value(s) configured below for each mode. If not set, status is inferred from temperature comparison.
data_description.hvac_status_off_values: PLC value(s) meaning OFF, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 0 or 0,10). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_heating_values: PLC value(s) meaning HEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_cooling_values: PLC value(s) meaning COOLING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 2 or 4,5). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_idle_values: Optional PLC value(s) meaning IDLE (neither heating nor cooling), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 9). Leave blank to treat any unmatched status as IDLE (default behavior).
data_description.hvac_status_drying_values: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DRYING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_fan_values: Optional PLC value(s) meaning FAN (circulating air only), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_preheating_values: Optional PLC value(s) meaning PREHEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.hvac_status_defrosting_values: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DEFROSTING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the climate entity.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.scan_interval: Override the poll interval for these tags in seconds. Leave blank to inherit the PLC default.
data_description.add_another: Stay on this step to add more climate entities.

edit_text.title: Edit Text
edit_text.description: Update the PLC address, command address, name, or pattern for this text entity.

data_description.address: PLC STRING or WSTRING address to read (e.g., DB1,S0.254, DB2,WS0.128).
data_description.command_address: PLC address to write text values (optional). If omitted, the state address is used.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the text entity.
data_description.area: Home Assistant area to assign this entity to.
data_description.pattern: Optional regex pattern to validate the text input.

data_description.heating_output_address: PLC address to control heating output (e.g., Q0.0, DB1,X0.0). Optional if only cooling is used.
data_description.cooling_output_address: PLC address to control cooling output (e.g., Q0.1, DB1,X0.1). Optional if only heating is used.
data_description.heating_action_address: Optional PLC address to read heating action state.
data_description.cooling_action_address: Optional PLC address to read cooling action state.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name for the climate entity.

on_off_address.label: On/off address
on_off_address.description: Optional boolean PLC address to switch this thermostat on/off, for devices with no native OFF mode of their own (e.g. a heater/cooler turned on/off by a separate output). Writes False/0 when the target mode is set to OFF, and True/1 for any other mode. Leave blank to rely on the standard OFF behavior instead. Also read back from the PLC to reflect the actual on/off state (bidirectional).

preset_mode_off_value.label: Off mode value
preset_mode_off_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to OFF (e.g. 0). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list. If on_off_address is configured, this is ignored for OFF: the mode stays available and is switched via that address instead.

preset_mode_heat_value.label: Heat mode value
preset_mode_heat_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT (e.g. 1). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_cool_value.label: Cool mode value
preset_mode_cool_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to COOL (e.g. 2). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_heat_cool_value.label: Heat/Cool (auto) mode value
preset_mode_heat_cool_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to HEAT/COOL (auto) (e.g. 3). Leave empty to hide this mode from the thermostat's mode list.

preset_mode_auto_value.label: Auto mode value
preset_mode_auto_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to AUTO (legacy alias for automatic heat/cool switching, similar to Heat/Cool). Disabled (left empty) by default.

preset_mode_dry_value.label: Dry mode value
preset_mode_dry_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to DRY (dehumidify only, no temperature control). Disabled (left empty) by default.

preset_mode_fan_only_value.label: Fan only mode value
preset_mode_fan_only_value.description: PLC value written when the mode is set to FAN ONLY (circulate air only, no heating/cooling). Disabled (left empty) by default.

hvac_status_address.label: HVAC status address
hvac_status_address.description: Optional PLC address to read the actual HVAC status, matched against the value(s) configured below for each mode. If not set, status is inferred from temperature comparison.

hvac_status_off_values.label: Off status value(s)
hvac_status_off_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning OFF, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 0 or 0,10). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_heating_values.label: Heating status value(s)
hvac_status_heating_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning HEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 1 or 2,3). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_cooling_values.label: Cooling status value(s)
hvac_status_cooling_values.description: PLC value(s) meaning COOLING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 2 or 4,5). Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_idle_values.label: Idle status value(s)
hvac_status_idle_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning IDLE (neither heating nor cooling), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas (e.g. 9). Leave blank to treat any unmatched status as IDLE (default behavior).

hvac_status_drying_values.label: Drying status value(s)
hvac_status_drying_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DRYING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_fan_values.label: Fan status value(s)
hvac_status_fan_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning FAN (circulating air only), read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_preheating_values.label: Preheating status value(s)
hvac_status_preheating_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning PREHEATING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

hvac_status_defrosting_values.label: Defrosting status value(s)
hvac_status_defrosting_values.description: Optional PLC value(s) meaning DEFROSTING, read from hvac_status_address. One or more integers separated by commas. Leave empty to skip this status (it will never be matched).

source_entity.label: Source entity
source_entity.description: Home Assistant entity whose value will be written to the PLC.

address.label: PLC address
address.description: PLC address to write the value (e.g., DB1,D0, DB2,W4).

invert_state.label: Invert state
invert_state.description: Invert binary states before writing them to a PLC BIT address.

control_behavior.label: Control behavior
control_behavior.sync_requires_different: Requires different state and command addresses.

direct.title: Direct control
direct.description: Home Assistant writes the command address and reads the state address. State and command remain independent.

sync.title: Synchronize command with state
sync.description: When the PLC state changes externally, the value read from the state address is also written to the command address. Useful when the PLC uses a command marker and a separate address or physical output as the real state.

pulse.title: Pulse control
pulse.description: Send a timed pulse to the command address instead of maintaining the ON/OFF value.

connection_details.title: Connection details
connection_details.description: Read-only connection parameters for this PLC.

availability.title: Connection availability
availability.timeline_label: PLC connection states over the last 24 hours
availability.history_unavailable: Historical data is not available; the current status is still shown above.
